title: Server-side t() leaves {{ name }} (with spaces) unreplaced while the Console replaces it, so a translation written in that form shows raw braces in server messages
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) out-of-scope finding from the #37894 card thread (PR #38090 acceptance notes; os-dev-report 7232137367), measured on objectstack origin/main 815e882b. Source: fleet.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：翻译里写成 `{{ name }}`（花括号里带空格，i18next 常见写法）时，控制台能替换，但服务端的两个 t()（`FileI18nAdapter` 和 `createMemoryI18n`）原样输出。服务端渲染的提示、通知里，用户会直接看到花括号。
- 修法：服务端两个 t() 和控制台一样，接受括号内两侧的空白；加一条两端行为一致的 pin。
- 优先级 p3：只影响用带空格写法的翻译。

## Measured (origin/main 815e882b)

- `FileI18nAdapter.t()` (service-i18n) and core `createMemoryI18n().t()` replace `{{name}}` and leave `{{ name }}` as is.
- The Console's i18next (default `{{ }}` interpolation) replaces both.
- #37894 (PR #38090) now tells authors to write `{{variable}}`. It does not teach the spaced form, so the gap surfaces only for authors who bring that habit from i18next.

## Ask

1. Both server `t()` accept optional whitespace inside the braces (`{{\s*name\s*}}`), matching the Console.
2. One pin that feeds the same bundle string to both server `t()` and asserts the same output as the Console for `{{name}}`, `{{ name }}` and the single-brace control.

## Acceptance

- `{{ name }}` is replaced on the server as in the Console. `{name}` (single brace) stays literal on both.
